subject: Transient compute allowance request — RetailGen 8hr throughput dry run
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@retailgen.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex@retailgen.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Transient compute uplift for overnight 8hr throughput dry run

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the onboarding call this week — RetailGen is ready to run the end-to-end throughput validation we discussed. We want to run an 8-hour dry run starting the night of Oct 8 to validate sustained token throughput and tail-latency under real payload distributions (see attached loadplan).

Can Redwood provision a transient compute allowance (temporary quota increase / trial runway extension) and a short-lived dedicated queue for that window? Key details:
- Window: Oct 8 01:00–09:00 UTC (8 hours)
- Target steady-state: ~18k tokens/sec aggregate, burst to 30k tokens/sec for up to 10m
- Goal: confirm 95th/99th percentile latency at 1.5k token seqs and measure KV cache effectiveness

We need an approval path and any necessary terms (SLA exception or temporary throttling agreements). Attached: retailgen-loadplan-8hr.xlsx with traffic shapes and test plan.

Let me know what you need from us to get this scheduled — we can be flexible on exact start if you have regional constraints.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering
RetailGen

<attachment: retailgen-loadplan-8hr.xlsx>

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@retailgen.ai>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex@retailgen.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transient compute uplift for overnight 8hr throughput dry run

Hi Priya — great to see the plan, and thanks for the attachment. We can support the run but need to coordinate a few items before we confirm the allocation:

1) Authorization: We'll need an approved transient allowance tied to RD-4821. Rishi — can we authorize a temporary sandbox allowance for a single 8-hour window?

2) Safety nets: For the burst to 30k tokens/sec, we recommend a staged ramp (we can enforce a soft-token cap at 25k for the first 20 minutes). Please confirm you can run the ramp steps in the spreadsheet.

3) Latency SLO exception: We can create a temporary SLO window for the test but we'll require an explicit acknowledgement of higher dispatch variance in that window. If you accept, we'll attach a short terms PDF to the allocation.

If Rishi approves, I can provision an isolated queue and a promo bridge code that grants the allowance. Camila — once provisioned please coordinate a smoke check run 24h prior. Monica, please add this to the renewal/expansion playbook for RD-4821.

Proposed provisional allocation: equivalent of 600k token units for the 8-hour window + isolated queue and elevated throttle thresholds.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

<attachment: redwood-terms-exception-request.pdf>

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@retailgen.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transient compute uplift for overnight 8hr throughput dry run

+1 from me. Approving the provisional allocation described below with the following controls:
- Allocation: 600,000 token units for a single 8-hour window (Oct 8 01:00–09:00 UTC).
- Isolation: dedicated queue, isolated from shared-host pool for the duration.
- Safety: automatic fallback to the compatible model-quantized variant if sustained 99th pct latency exceeds 3s for >10m.
- Billing: mark as promotional allowance against RD-4821; track usage in HubSpot (deal RD-4821) and mark as trial-extension.

Camila — please assign an ops owner and schedule the 24h smoke check. Monica — I'll send a quick note to HubSpot and attach the terms.

Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Transient compute uplift for overnight 8hr throughput dry run

Thanks Rishi — that's perfect. Quick clarification before we lock in:
- For the fallback model-quantized variant, can you confirm whether output fidelity logging will still include token-level deltas so we can validate result drift?
- If the fallback is triggered, will you notify us via the Redwoods console and also open a ticket so we can correlate with our test harness?

We accept the temporary SLO window and will sign the terms PDF you attached. Also, can GCP Sales be looped in to confirm there are no region-specific capacity constraints for Oct 8?

—Priya

On Fri, Oct 2, 2026 at 07:18 AM Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:

All set — allocation scheduled pending DocuSign and the smoke check pass. Action items:
- Priya: sign the attached temporary-terms PDF (I've also uploaded a copy to the Drive link above).
- Mina/Rishi: issue promo bridge code and confirm isolated queue name (we'll use: retailgen-rd4821-8hr-prv).
- Camila (ops): run smoke check Oct 7 01:00 UTC; post metrics to the Drive folder.
- Monica: add the allowance to RD-4821 renewal notes and set reminder for post-mortem with Customer Success.

If smoke check passes we'll flip the allocation live Oct 8 01:00 UTC. Priya — please confirm signature timeline and whether Alex will be available for the smoke check.

Thanks everyone,
Camila Reyes
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
